global_summary: The conspect covers the complete reCAPTCHA request lifecycle: expose only the site key to the client, obtain a short-lived token, send it with the business request, verify it server-side with the secret key, and apply v2/v3-specific checks before continuing registration or another protected action.

regions.summary: Core flow and trust boundary: site key vs secret key, token acquisition, form submission, server siteverify call, hostname/action notes, and why client-side success alone is not authoritative.

reCAPTCHA v2 in Razor and React, both library and manual script/widget approaches, DTO/model binding, reusable ASP.NET Core verifier/service, controller flow, failure reset, and combined v2/v3 abstractions.
reCAPTCHA v3 in Razor and React, manual grecaptcha.execute and provider-library approaches, expected action, score threshold, backend checks, and request/controller integration.
Optional remoteip handling and proxy correctness: forwarded headers, real client IP retrieval, when remoteip is useful, and when sending a wrong proxy address reduces its value.

reading_quality.limitations: Exact punctuation and package API details remain anchored by preserved source PNGs; semantic flow and major code shapes were readable.
